note: Hand moves applied after the category engine ranks the Light the Lamp board (src/lib/leagues/rank-adjustments.ts). They correct projection defects that live in the shared players.json, which the Fantrax league and the dynasty build also read, so the fix stays local to this board. The games-played moves of 2026-09-27 (Marner, Andersson, Matheson, Faulk, Dorofeyev, Panarin, Aho, Toffoli) were dropped on 2026-10-02: the iron-man GP haircut they offset is fixed at its root (out-of-sample GP calibration, coherent dataset). Algorithm: remove every listed row from the engine order, then re-insert each at index insertAt - 1, deepest insertAt first; shallower re-inserts push deeper ones down, so a row can end a few ranks below its insertAt. engineRank is the engine rank the move was decided against: check:draft-board warns when the engine no longer agrees. reason is shown on the site (French).
